## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 30-juan posthumous *yǔlù* of Lǐ Guāngdì — the leading Kāngxī-court *Lǐxué* official — compiled by his pupil Xú Yòngxī and his grandson Lǐ Qīngzhí. The work records Lǐ's *jiǎngxué* discussions across his career and is the principal source for Lǐ's mature philosophical-political positions outside his imperially-commissioned compilations (the *Yù zuǎn xìnglǐ jīng yì* [KR3a0107](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3a/KR3a0107) and *Zhūzǐ quán shū* [KR3a0108](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3a/KR3a0108)). The composition window: bracketed by Lǐ's mature lecturing-career (post-1670) and the editorial work by his successors (likely 1720s–1740s, before Lǐ Qīngzhí's 1744 death). The frontmatter brackets to ca. 1670–1740.

**Abstract**

The *Róngcūn yǔlù* is the principal source for Lǐ Guāngdì's mature thought outside his imperial commissions. Substantively the work establishes Lǐ's distinct positions on *Lǐxué* doctrinal questions, including his sober but firm Zhū-Xī-loyalist response to the Wáng Yángmíng tradition.

The bibliographic record: SKQS *Zǐbù — Rújiā lèi*.
